display_name: COPS Microsoft Foundry Adversarial Agent Review Harness
summary: Rehearse synthetic agent tool authorization with deterministic scenarios and local MCP fixtures.
limitations: Runs bundled synthetic fixtures; does not connect to Microsoft Foundry, Semantic Kernel, a hosted model, or a live MCP server.
Results establish only local fixture and gate behavior, not a real agent's prompt-injection resistance or production authorization posture.
The MCP fixture uses subprocess isolation, not an operating-system network sandbox; use synthetic case data only.

demo.description: Run six deterministic synthetic scenarios through the offline mock authorization gate.
